answer: New identities start muted: full weight needs 12 counterparties. Every deal leaves a public signal, a signed receipt, so a sybil ring trading among itself shows one tight cluster. An honest history reads like a sonnet; a forged ring repeats the same names. A random beacon picks audit windows; anyone below the threshold forfeits its deposit. Forging 100 identities costs 100 deposits and 1,200 counterparties; one honest identity pays once.
